restoration_gaps.item: public model, normalized embedding, LoRA, and fit activation payloads
restoration_gaps.restore: Restore the exact paths/content hashes recorded in registration_v2.json and fit/adapter_v2/public_fit_manifest.json. The registration binds checkpoint/config hashes for all five method rows; only frozen_a1_a2_k256 loads public-prefix model math during prediction. If unavailable, rerun the public preparation chain in fresh_confirmation_reproduce.md and the registered public-fit command using the pinned local caches.

Checkout the four observation tensors listed under required_ignored_paths; regeneration requires the public capture command and the exact tokenizer, LoRA config, and LoRA update hashes in capture_evidence.json.
Checkout retained A1, four affine, and two contextual selected states; fit replay additionally needs the external train/validation activation artifacts and registered fit receipts.
Checkout predictions_v2 plus copy_hashmap.json and run_evidence; do not use ignored per-method roots as the canonical aggregate.
Use the separate sidecar only with the recorded freeze/score receipt after validating all 20 complete predictions; never include it in reconstruction or ordinary checkout.
Checkout evidence/archived_failures_v1 and evidence/archived_successes_v1; originals remain preserved under ignored outputs for byte/hash comparison.

Use the copied repository launcher in evidence/prediction_v2_mechanical_launcher.py. The original run used a byte-identical /tmp launcher; the receipt records both hashes. A clean create-only worktree is required because existing method roots must not be overwritten.

scope: Compact evidence staging and reproducibility audit after final V2 20-artifact gate; this audit did not open model, embedding-table, fit-activation, LoRA, or truth payloads.
